about: Corrections to Wikidata's heads of state and government, applied by build.mjs after Wikidata (leaders.mjs, applyCorrections). Each: iso3 (World Bank code), field (headOfState or headOfGovernment), name (the right name), source (the address it was checked at), checked (YYYY-MM-DD), replaces (the Wikidata value it replaces, or null for none), note (why, optional). A correction applies only while Wikidata still gives the value it replaces, so it lapses by itself once Wikidata is put right; the build logs each one applied and each one lapsed. A regent (field regent) is a correction of its own kind: the person who exercises the head of state's powers on his behalf, with qid, since and actsFor (the head of state he acts for, as Wikidata names him) and replaces null; it changes neither head, makes the regent the current leader where the head of state's office holds the power, and applies only while Wikidata's head of state is still actsFor.

National Analysis names Alois as the current leader (Jude, 12 November 2026).
